Calculates length of {{{<nowiki/>1}}}.

==Examples==
<pre>{{str/len|abc}}</pre>
&rarr; {{str/len|abc}}

<pre>{{str/len|Dwarf Fortress}}</pre>
&rarr; {{str/len|Dwarf Fortress}}

<pre>{{str/len|a
b}}</pre>
&rarr; {{str/len|a
b}}

==Caveats==
<pre>{{str/len|<nowiki/>}}</pre>
&rarr; {{str/len|<nowiki/>}}

This is due to MediaWiki's implementation of &lt;nowiki> &mdash; &lt;nowiki> tags are replaced with an identifier when parsed. For example, <code>&lt;nowiki>text&lt;/nowiki></code> becomes {{wikisrc|<nowiki>text</nowiki>}}. (Note that {{action|purge||purging this page}} will display a different token, despite the contents being the same.)
